title: The Slow Letters Anew
author: Vesper Reyes
blurb: Kestrel Brightwater, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
